finalText:
**It's a small JSON API in plain Node — five files, no dependencies, no package.json.**

```mermaid
graph LR
  server[server.js] --> auth[auth.js]
  server --> routes[routes.js]
  routes --> cache[cache.js]
  routes --> store[store.js]
  cache --> store
```

`server.js` checks the token, then hands the request to `routes.js`, which matches `"METHOD /path"` against a small table of three endpoints. Reads go through `cache.js`, a 256-entry in-memory cache. Writes go straight to `store.js`, a `Map` where every record dies 15 minutes after its last write. Tokens are `userId.hmac` signed with `AUTH_SECRET`, which falls back to `dev-secret`.

One thing to know: the comment in `routes.js` says writes clear the affected cache keys, but nothing does. After a `POST /orders`, a `GET /orders` keeps serving the old list forever.
